title: Bounded runtime-shard metrics work item
summary: Expose bounded shard queue depth and work distribution metrics for high-concurrency diagnosis without changing scheduling behavior.
planned_changes: Add shard-scoped inbox depth and bounded per-kind enqueue/dequeue instruments to the existing Incursa.Quic Meter. Preserve disabled-listener guards and existing runtime scheduling semantics.
verification_plan: Run focused MeterListener, shard scheduler, disposal, and timer tests; run the complete QUIC test project; validate SpecTrace JSON; and confirm a ProtocolLab counter capture produces the shard summary artifact.
completion_notes: Added shard-only queue depth and bounded shard_index/work_item_kind enqueue/dequeue measurements. Timer wakes and due timer work use the same paired accounting as other shard work, and failed enqueue attempts emit no measurements.
out_of_scope: Connection, stream, endpoint, address, or raw-error metric tags
Changing shard count or routing policy
Treating diagnostics as benchmark or publishability evidence
